tagline: Fast, private, browser-based tools. No sign-up, no tracking, nothing ever leaves your device.
_comment: siteUrl here is only the LAST-RESORT fallback used when scripts/lib/site-url.js can't detect a real one — see that file. The build auto-detects the actual URL from SITE_URL / Vercel / Netlify / Cloudflare Pages / GitHub Pages env vars, in that order, so this placeholder is normally never used once deployed on a supported platform. It still needs a real value for any build run outside of those (e.g. a local `npm run build` you intend to publish elsewhere).
